_comment: Merge the hooks object into ~/.claude/settings.json (or the vault's .claude/settings.json). Paths assume the repo was cloned to ~/singularity; edit if not. Raw capture lands in ~/.claude/capture/raw/, outside the vault, because it can contain secrets.

hooks.command: echo '=== POST-COMPACTION === Re-read before continuing: OS/Manual/Start Here.md, the HEARTBEAT tail, the last 2 Conversation Log entries, this session CHECKPOINT.md and DECISIONS.md. Do not trust pre-compaction memory for status, money or scope. ==='
